native_mimo.body:
Reviewed PR #3 (codex/cephalon-bounded-graph-recall → main) end-to-end: all 229 pages of the immutable full diff (101 files, 20,107 insertions, 0 deletions) were read and individually assessed. The change is a bounded four-package import (graph-claim-core recall/claims ClojureScript, openplanner-sdk TypeScript, stores/cache, stores/document-hydration) plus workspace/lockfile/CI wiring, RED→GREEN verification evidence, and an append-only receipts ledger.

Deterministic evidence: summary.json/deterministic.log report result=success with exact_head, clean_checkout, diff_stat=0, diff_hygiene=0 and no errors (stat/hygiene gates only). The scoped-graph-recall workflow independently exercises JVM recall tests, scoped lint, a zero-warning compile, and three verification scripts including a forced-child-exit-1 proof.

Core recall logic held up under adversarial reading: closed Malli contracts, stored-snapshot validation before admission, assert-current! after every await, provenance/$elemMatch budget filters, bounded row limits with maxTimeMS and honest error mapping, deterministic fixed-point seeding, and claim lifecycle/policy purity. Evidence JSONs and receipts document genuine RED→GREEN trajectories with explicit limits (held ports, no native approval claims).

Confirmed findings (both non-blocking):
1. Medium, semantic-regression — packages/openplanner-sdk/src/embedding-cache.ts:11: makeEmbeddingCacheKey truncates text to 128 chars with no hash, so two distinct texts sharing a 128-char prefix collide on the same cache/in-flight key and the second text silently receives the first text's embedding (same-batch in-flight dedup and cross-call putMany/getMany both affected). Fix: key on model + full text or a hash of the full text.
2. Low, contract — packages/stores/document-hydration/README.md:16: the README lists createRedisCache as a re-exported facade helper, but the shadow-cljs :exports map, index.d.ts, the facade namespace, and the entire store-cache package contain no such symbol. Fix: drop the bullet or add the export.

Non-blocking notes: clj-kondo await excludes are deliberately scoped to two recall namespaces; transitive lockfile deprecation notices (glob/tar/inflight) live only in dev-tool chains with no demonstrated path into shipped recall code; a cosmetic missing backtick in the graph README; a pre-existing duplicate license key in the root package.json is not introduced by this PR. No critical/high/blocking findings — no demonstrated failure of a security, authorization, persistence, or state-transition invariant.
